verdicts.reason: Both candidates are practically the same layout. The only difference is that B's 'Find a Store' button sits a few pixels further right. Both share the same flaws. The peach circle sits behind the body copy, and the green circle's top is cut off by the canvas edge. The 'SOLSTICE' label on the can is too small to read. The headline is jammed between the product and the copy row, and the small body copy has to compete with the CTA on one cramped bottom line.
